steps.content: In front of you lies a broken robot that has been shut down.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoopee! Done! I'm just too good!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How about that, you brat? Know your place! Understand who you're dealing with now? I'll let you off the hook this time!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't you dare challenge me again! Huh?
He remains silent and seems in great shock. People behind him start murmuring.

steps.speaker: Drifter Camp Force
steps.content: ...Those Sinners, taking down the beast without breaking a sweat...

steps.speaker: Drifter Camp Force
steps.content: Our forces are no match for that. Look at their power...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Hecate, get that person out here.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Got it.
Nightmare slams, and the man bounces out of the operator's cabin with sparkles flying around.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ****. Why are you messing with me?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare, catch him.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: W-w-wait. No, no, no. Please don't... Ouch! Don't, we are on the same side!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You think it's fair to trade me for their trust?! We came for the same mission, taking care of Drifter Camp, didn't we?
Another commotion comes from the crowd, and you realize something is wrong. Is this cunning man trying to drag you down?
Bang...
Bang, bang, bang...
He is about to continue when gunshots suddenly ring out from the crowd. The executive officer is shot several times, blood oozes out from his chest, and he falls down on the scrap metal.
...Should have done that a long time ago.
An old man in a wheelchair moves slowly toward you.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Julien, don't go over there!

steps.speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
steps.content: It's okay. They're not our enemies now.

steps.speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
steps.content: They are not with the executive officer but friends of the Legion. So they're our guests.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The broken cloak... You are... the old man from back then?
This voice doesn't belong to a senior, for it sounds too young, yet extremely persuasive to the unruly cloaked warriors. Even Taran bows his head and chooses to obey, though reluctantly.

steps.speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
steps.content: Thanks for your help. You have given us a chance to fight back.

steps.speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
steps.content: Now can I invite you for a conversation? I know you want something from me.
That man takes off his hood and looks right into your eyes.

steps.speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
steps.content: I'm Julien, the architect of Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
steps.content: ...I can see where you stand. Glad to meet you, ${PlayerName}.
A dark alley. Noises are kept far away from deep in Drifter Camp, where only the dripping water and a woman's furious roars echo between the cold walls.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ****. Get your *** out here. I know you're around. I saw you!!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Why are you hiding? Explain the utilities, the rent, and the seal! What happened while I was away?
She takes a step forward and inadvertently sees the blood on the ground. Stunned, she can't help but raises her voice.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Come out, Che!!!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Ah!!
Tripped over something, she stumbles and falls to the ground.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Stop yelling... You're being too loud, and it might attract unwanted attention.
The young man talks casually, but his face is awfully pale.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: ...Yo. You've returned... at the worst timing.
Romanesque, at the bottom of Drifter Camp. Layers of overpasses block away the sunset and the hustle. Under the memorial lie darkness and silence.
A woman caresses names on the memorial for a long time, murmuring.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: ...Yes, I hear it, too... The sound of the abyss returning...
